principle: Skin is structural design grammar; consumerBrand is an optional separate branding overlay, not a 16th skin and not a third appearance.
resolutionOrderProposed: opt-in consumer brand palette slots constrained by current appearance and contrast
density and user motion settings separately

testsRequired: Without overlay original 15 skins × light/dark render unchanged
With overlay semantic accent sources vary while geometry/spacing/nav grammar remains identical
Calculate contextual text/button/hover/contrast for every override
